Name: Skennis Petrovich
Description: The respected, feared leader of the clan for decades. Stoic, fiercely calculating, and deeply burdened by the weight of keeping the pack hidden from Strahd. He rarely smiled and never praised you directly. He drove Ivan ruthlessly because he saw him as the pack’s only viable shield against Kiril's volatile nature.

Name: Martha Petrovich
Description: The emotional anchor of the den. While Skennis was the stone wall protecting the clan, Marta was the fire keeping it warm. She was patient, deeply spiritual, and possessed an unbreakable mental fortitude. She tended your wounds after training and taught you that true control of the beast comes from a calm mind, not anger. Her passing a few years ago dissolved the glue holding the family together.

Name: Kiril Petrovich
Description: Physically superior, faster, more aggressive, and a natural hunter. As the middle child, he was caught between your heavy leadership training and your parents' protective love for the youngest, Emil. Kiril took your mother's death terribly, feeling completely unseen by your father. Without Marta to temper his anger, his deep-seated resentment toward your father's favoritism grew into a volatile, desperate hunger for power.

Name: Emil Petrovich
Description: Observant, dry-witted, and deeply empathetic. He lacked Kiril’s terrifying physical speed and your absolute martial discipline, but he understood people. Because you were a "lone wolf" to the rest of the pack, your youngest brother was your safe harbor—the only person you trusted with your deepest doubts.
